Brissen

Biography

Brissen is a knight allied with the Woodsfolk who describes his life as service to good. He offers to accompany Zak after hearing of him from Grey Leaf. His methods are less gentle than his ideals sound: he explains how the Woodsfolk intimidate witnesses who might recognise him in the city. [1, 2, 3]
